decisions.reason: Rye country bread builds closely on the firm's established baking knowledge, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it, making a drop unlikely.
Premium raisin Christmas stollen is a flagship close to existing stollen expertise and externally validated by a gold medal, so the firm can continue to assimilate and commercialize it.
Rye mixed bread with seeds draws on familiar recipes and processes, enabling the firm to learn from feedback and continue commercializing it.
Dark barley malt rye bread is close to established bread-making knowledge, so existing expertise lets the firm interpret results and refine rather than drop.
Marzipan Christmas stollen is close to the firm's existing stollen offer, permitting use of prior knowledge to assess and refine it.
